Empires & Puzzles Jolyon Review: The Thoughtful Faun Guide

Jolyon brings a unique 'dodge-then-summon' mechanic to the battlefield. Is this artistic Faun a masterpiece of defense or just a happy accident? We break down his stats, skills, and why he might be the niche counter you didn't know you needed.
Jolyon: The Bob Ross of Dodging
Jolyon, The Thoughtful Faun: Dodging Reality (and Damage) One Brushstroke at a Time
Jolyon is a 5-Star Legendary Ice hero from the

family, released in May 2025. He arrives as a curious support hero who tries to blend two distinct mechanics—dodging and minion summoning—into a single, slightly over-complicated package. With his painter's apron and satchel of brushes, he looks ready to paint a happy little tree over your enemies' graves, or perhaps just dodge their insults. While not a pure powerhouse, his unique "dodge once, then minion" mechanic offers a specific kind of protection that can be frustrating to deal with if not timed correctly.

Jolyon brings a refreshing, non-combatant aesthetic to the game. He’s depicted as a "Thoughtful Faun Tinkerer," complete with Ram horns, a blue painter's outfit, and floating wooden dolls that look suspiciously like voodoo effigies. The art style is vibrant and leans into the whimsical side of the Woodland Faun family. It’s a nice change of pace from the usual armored warriors screaming at the sky, though the floating dolls add a layer of "haunted toyshop" energy that you may or may not find comforting.
Jolyon's stats reflect his release timing in mid-2025. With a base Power of 1182, he is sitting noticeably behind the late-2025 power creep curve, where new heroes are pushing 1260-1280 Power.
This is quite low by modern standards (top strikers are 1300+). However, as a support hero, his job isn't to deal damage, so this is forgivable.

His bulk is decent. His HP is actually still very competitive, rivaling even the newest heroes who sit around the 2260 mark. This high health pool is critical for his minions, as they inherit 30% of his HP.

If you pulled Jolyon early, congratulations! He will carry you through hard map stages. His minions act like a massive heal, and the dodge will save your under-leveled heroes from being one-shot by bosses. Max him out and use the Health path.

Jolyon is a situational tool. You won't use him in your main war defense, but he is a valuable asset for your 4th or 5th war attack team, specifically to counter teams that rely on Status Ailments (like Cubes or Vampires). If you can dodge the initial damage and keep the minion, their DoT effects become useless.

Jolyon is the Bob Ross of Empires & Puzzles: he believes there are no mistakes, just happy little accidents (where the enemy misses you entirely). While he lacks the raw aggression of modern meta heroes, his ability to provide a massive 75% dodge followed by a thick, immunity-granting minion is a powerful combo in the right hands. He won't speed up your matches, but he will give you the canvas you need to paint your own victory.
A solid, if quirky, support hero who shines in Bloody Battle and against specific heavy-hitting defenses. Keep him for the niche, love him for the style.
